finalJustifications: Because automatic backups combine daily snapshots + CONTINUOUS archiving of transaction logs — the RDS Reconstructs the state of any moment of the retention window in a new instance.
Because RDS record a full snapshot every minute of the day, and the punctual restoration chooses the closest snapshot to the moment desired by the administrator.
Because transaction logs are stored within the standby instance of Multi-AZ, which serves as a historical source for timely reconstruction.
Because the point-in-time restore uses read replicas as a historical source: each replica keeps a different time window from the production database.

finalJustifications: Because RDS Proxy keeps a pool shared that invocations reuse — the bank stops bursting connections and the failover gets faster by preserving connections in transition.
Because RDS Proxy converts persistent connections into calls HTTP without state, eliminating the concept of connection limit in the bank.
Because RDS Proxy executes the queries in a cache itself and returns the result without touching the bank, saving the connections to the writings.
Because RDS Proxy limits each Lambda to a life connection reused in all invocations, keeping the total below the limit.

finalJustifications: ♪ 'Cause the date of the day sends ♪ TODAS the day's writings for the same partition (hot partition): the correction is key to high cardinality (user ID, data+suffix shard) to spread the load..
Because the key by date automatically expires at midnight, and throttling is the symptom of mass cleaning competing with the writings of the peak.

Because hot partitions are solved by increasing the total capacity provided: with more RCUs and WCUs in the table, each partition inherits a larger ceiling.

finalJustifications: Because GSI materializes the table with the e-mail as partition key: the search becomes a cheap and direct Query in the index, eliminating the full Scan.
Because GSI creates a B-tree index within the main table, accelerating the Scan without needing a separate structure.
Because GSI transforms the Scan into an automatic parallel scan of 8 threads, dividing the table into segments.
Because GSI store only the emails of the customers, reducing the cost of reading the query in orders of magnitude.

finalJustifications: Because DAX speaks to MESMA API of the DynamoDB: just point the client to the cluster — read-through/write-through cache without writing popular/disable logic as required by ElastiCache.
Because DAX is enabled by default in the on-demand tables — auctions only need to activate the accelerated endpoint on the console of the DynamoDB.
Because DAX scale the table's provided capacity along with the cache, absorbing the reading peaks of items in high without throttling.
Because DAX runs without any cluster, directly at SDK application — the library saves hot items in the local memory of the process.

finalJustifications: Because the endpoint reader of Aurora balance the connections between the replicas automatically — just the application send the readings to this endpoint.
Because the endpoint reader converts readings into writing when the label is free, taking advantage of idle ability.
Because the endpoint reader requires the RDS Proxy in front to work, and it's the proxy that makes the connection balancing.
Because the endpoint reader doubles the replicas in peak times, doubling the readability automatically.

Because Serverless v2 migrates queries to DynamoDB in the registration peaks, returning them to PostgreSQL when the load normalizes.
Because Serverless v2 is free below 1 ACU, and the academic system only pays in the weeks when it exceeds this consumption floor.
